text: きみも　しはんの　ファンに　なるといいっす　ウスッ！

structure.jp: しはんの　ファンに　なるといいっす
structure.en: should become a fan of the master

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: といい after a verb says 'it would be good if you did', a soft way to suggest something. なるといい = 'you should become one'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what someone turns into. ファンに　なる = 'become a fan'.
